title: Indexing a year of video locally on a 2021 MacBook with Gemma4-31B (50GB swap)
summary: A detailed walkthrough of running Google's 31B parameter Gemma4 model locally on a 2021 MacBook with 50GB of swap memory to index and search through a year's worth of video content, demonstrating the feasibility of running large AI models on consumer hardware.
problem_solved: Enables local video content indexing and semantic search without relying on cloud-based AI services or expensive dedicated hardware.
why_valuable: Demonstrates practical democratization of AI by running a 31B parameter model on everyday consumer hardware, saving costs and preserving privacy while achieving useful results.
